completion_definition: Done iff all five original ACs are satisfied, every mandatory frozen cell has passing independently asserted evidence, every conditional cell has a proved typed boundary and reviewed disposition, and complete final CI passes. Scope changes require separate reviewed contract revision.

required: 9 deterministic golden source and output cases
AC1.pass: all mandatory cells have independent typed source/output and TRUE/NOT TRUE assertions; no untested exact variant

required: all 42 x 13 parser and semantic-equivalence statuses
meaning-changing dialect/session cases preserve typed residual
AC2.pass: 546 dialect cells classified with fixture evidence, no unverified parser/canonical cells

required: finite integer source including NULL, duplicates, -2147483648 and 2147483647
closed-world physical-source and rejected-terminal DuckDB comparison
AC3.pass: all listed oracle cases independently execute with pinned SQL/seed, and each feasibility/impossibility/residual claim agrees

required: canonical Rust model and emitted JSON parity
active schema and documentation changes only when contract changes
AC4.pass: every adapter cell either passes equivalence test or has reviewed explicit metadata-not-representable rationale

required: no false exactness or unsupported silent gaps
all required+conditional cells closed or approved
schema snapshots and deterministic JSON regression
AC5.pass: all CI gates green on final PR SHA, 0 unverified cells, 0 unapproved deferrals, original AC #1..#5 signed

inventory_cells.sql_shape: SELECT s FROM t WHERE s LIKE 'ab%'
inventory_cells.exactness_floor: Wildcard-free equality and safe ASCII prefix LIKE must be proven exact under binary/no-padding assumptions.

inventory_cells.sql_shape: SELECT s FROM t WHERE s ILIKE 'ab%'
inventory_cells.exactness_floor: Portable binary-collation, no-padding, safe ASCII LIKE/ESCAPE proof only where attested; unsupported Unicode/regex variants must be classified.
inventory_cells.conditional_boundary: Engine/collation-dependent case folding and Unicode behavior; cannot silently reuse binary LIKE.

inventory_cells.sql_shape: SELECT s FROM t WHERE s LIKE 'ab!_%' ESCAPE '!'
inventory_cells.exactness_floor: Safe, single-character inert ESCAPE subset is mandatory exact; semantics outside preconditions residual.

inventory_cells.conditional_boundary: Regex grammar and dialect operator semantics differ.

scope_policy.mandatory_exactness: Exact-required cells cannot be reclassified as residual solely for missing implementation; preconditions and typed bounds must be tested
scope_policy.conditional: A conditional row is not a waiver: parser/session assumption + typed residual or certified exact+owner+review are required
scope_policy.engine_claims: Only DuckDB executed; parser acceptance never attests execution on other vendor engines
scope_policy.new_variants: Newly discovered SQL variants after freeze go to separate backlog tasks unless they invalidate a mandatory current correctness claim
scope_policy.parents: TASK-108 signs off TASK-70; TASK-88/89/91 maintain independent gates; no change in this freeze marks them Done

dialect_verification.classification_limits: Parser acceptance and dialect-normalized protocol JSON equality are separate from vendor runtime execution and from typed physical witness correctness. Conditional AST/session semantics remain conditional until independently justified.

case_execution_verification.evidence_limits: Reproducible DuckDB golden sources and existing TASK-101..106 composition tests; not a certification that all 28 mandatory variants are semantically exact or that every adapter/conditional cell is closed.

semantic_proof_status.rules: Two-direction exact/impossible predicate proofs and independent physical DuckDB source oracle required; typed projected domain exactness cannot be inferred solely from SQL/dbt adapter parity or runtime output bags.
